name: Buy And Sell Stocks - Infinite Transactions Allowed
statement:
1. You are given a number n, representing the number of days.
2. You are given n numbers, where ith number represents price of stock on ith day.
3. You are required to print the maximum profit you can make if you are allowed infinite transactions.
Note - There can be no overlapping transaction. One transaction needs to be closed (a buy followed by a sell) before opening another transaction (another buy)
inputFormat:
A number n
.. n more elements
outputFormat: A number representing the maximum profit you can make if you are allowed infinite transactions.
